description.value: Paragon Tea Room is a Hong Kong-founded tea cafe specializing in Japanese matcha and hojicha drinks, botanical wellness teas, and handcrafted pastries. With roots in Hong Kong's blend of Eastern and Western culture, the brand has grown to four BC locations including this Richmond outpost. Touring cyclists will find a sit-down cafe experience with pastry and drink options available for dine-in, pickup, or delivery.

address.value: 4328 Number 3 Rd Unit 140, Richmond, BC V6X 2C2

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 45m; rack at 88m.
